name: Exage LT 3×7 combined shift/brake pair
weight_description: Not yet sourced: complete ST-M320 left/right 3×7 combined shift/brake pair. The scanned dealer-table mass is not clearly legible enough to publish; ST-M520’s mass is not substituted.
